name: shipit
description: Spec-driven development for any repo. `init` detects your stack, commands, layers and tests from evidence; `task` turns a need into a tracker ticket or an epic; `plan` writes a contract in your checkout (parallel worktrees are opt-in); `implement` executes and verifies it; `handoff` is the only skill that touches git or GitHub, and it does branch, commit, push and the PR body only — no tracker writes, ever.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement and deliver work under a contract generated from your own repo
interface.longDescription: shipit detects your conventions instead of assuming them. `init` reads the repository once, writes a contract at `.sdd/`, and points `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` at it so any agent loads it; `task`, `plan`, `implement`, `pr-fix` and `handoff` all work from that contract, so nothing in the plugin needs to know your framework. `task` drafts a Linear, Jira, Shortcut or GitHub ticket — one, or an epic split into independently shippable subtasks — and leaves creating it to you. Parallel worktrees are opt-in, and git and GitHub writes happen only in `handoff`, which never touches your tracker.
defaultPrompt: Run shipit init on this repo.
Turn this need into a ticket with shipit.
